steps.title: Understanding the Basics
steps.content: Arc Raiders is a PvPvE extraction shooter. Your goal is to land in Topside, loot valuable resources, and extract before the ARC or other Raiders take you out.

steps.title: Choose Your Loadout
steps.content: Start with the Free Loadout Augment and a basic weapon. As you progress, craft better gear at workbenches.

steps.title: Learn the Maps
steps.content: Study the map layouts, extraction points, and high-loot areas. Knowledge of the terrain is your best weapon.

steps.title: Gathering Materials
steps.content: Collect Metal Parts, Plastic Parts, Chemicals, and other basic materials from loot areas during expeditions.

steps.title: Workbench Tiers
steps.content: Different weapons require different workbench tiers. Higher tier weapons need Gunsmith II or III.

steps.title: Blueprint System
steps.content: You need blueprints to craft most advanced weapons. Find them in Topside or complete specific quests.

steps.title: Reach the Dam
steps.content: Navigate through the Dam Battleground map to find the quest objective marker.

steps.title: Activate the Terminal
steps.content: Interact with the terminal near the main dam structure to begin the event.

steps.title: Defend the Position
steps.content: Hold your position against waves of ARC enemies while the data downloads.

steps.title: Know Your Enemy
steps.content: Each ARC type has unique weaknesses. Learn which weapons work best against each one.

steps.title: Use the Environment
steps.content: ARCs can be stunned, trapped, and even turned against each other using environmental hazards.

steps.title: Enter the Spaceport
steps.content: Access the Spaceport through the main gate or the underground tunnels.

steps.title: Find the Control Room
steps.content: Navigate through the corridors to locate the central control room.
